description: Northgard is a Viking-themed strategy game. This randomizer covers Conquest mode: complete your Conquest map, solo or in co-op, by winning Chapter 7. Progress through the branching tree of Chapters is gated by items received from the multiworld; completing a Chapter's battle sends its location checks.

Check out the [README](https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard) for more information!

2026.07.27.title: 2026.07.27 - Initial Release!

2026.07.28.description:
### FIXED
- The Conquest map now updates instantly when a Chapter unlocks. No more backing out to the main menu and back in to see it reflected.
- Fixed the "next Chapter unlocked" reveal animation sometimes showing a Chapter as playable even though it wasn't actually unlocked yet.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.07.27...2026.07.28
2026.07.28.title: 2026.07.28 - Auto-Map Update

2026.07.28.2.description:
### FIXED
- Added an `archipelago.json` manifest to the released `.apworld`. Archipelago core requires this starting in 0.7.0.
- Added `tools/build_apworld.py` to package `worlds/northgard/` into `northgard.apworld`, stamping in each release's version automatically instead of building the zip by hand.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.07.28...2026.07.28.2
2026.07.28.2.title: 2026.07.28.2 - Manifest.json Hotfix

2026.08.03.description:
### FIXED
- Rare crash (patch_northgard.exe - Application Error, 0xc0000142) that could occur when connecting to a room, caused by two client instances racing to extract and execute the same patch binary.
- Possible corruption of hlboot.dat if two client windows (two rooms open at once) both auto-healed the same Northgard install at the same time.
- Connecting to a room no longer briefly freezes the client while the in-game patch is checked/applied.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.07.28.2...2026.08.03
2026.08.03.title: 2026.08.03 - Minor Fixes to Patch Application

2026.08.04.description:
### Fixed
- Stale Chapter-unlock markers left over from a previous Conquest save or room could falsely unlock an unrelated node in a brand-new save whenever Northgard's random battle-name pool reused the same name (e.g. a fresh save's Chapter 06 - Top could appear unlocked before ever being earned). The client now continuously reconciles unlock markers against whichever save is actually pinned, removing any that don't belong to it.
### Changed
- Simplified the setup guide's connection order: you no longer need to create a Conquest save before connecting the client for the first time -- the in-game lock-enforcement patch applies on connect regardless of whether a save exists yet. You just need to make sure Northgard itself is closed before opening the client.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.08.03...2026.08.04
2026.08.04.title: 2026.08.04 - Fixed Left Over Markers

2026.08.15.description:
### Changed
- Removed unused internal save-reading helper functions and other minor code cleanup in the client. No user-facing behavior change.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.08.04...2026.08.15
2026.08.15.title: 2026.08.15 - Code Cleanup

2026.08.15.2.description:
### Fixed
- Non-Linear Progression Mode: the region/location logic itself was still enforcing Linear Mode's ancestor-adjacency rule, so generation and trackers required an adjacent Chapter to be reached first before a later one counted as logically accessible -- even though the in-game client already unlocked Chapters correctly out of order. A Chapter's location is now logically reachable the moment its own item is received, matching the in-game behavior.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.08.15...2026.08.15.2
2026.08.15.2.title: 2026.08.15.2 - Non-Linear Mode Logic Fix

2026.08.16.description:
### Fixed
- Winning the second same-Chapter battle (top/bottom) wasn't sending the proper checks.
- Non-Linear Mode: the Conquest map could get permanently stuck (no nodes clickable, Escape not working) after winning a battle out of the usual order.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.08.15.2...2026.08.16
2026.08.16.title: 2026.08.16 - More Polishing Fixes

2026.08.27.description:
### Fixed
- Northgard's updates shuffled its internal function numbers, breaking chapter-lock enforcement. It's should now be fixed by having the patcher find functions by name instead of a fixed number, so it survives future updates.
- The "already patched?" check just compared file bytes, so it falsely said "patched" right after the update and auto-heal never kicked in. It should now be fixed by checking the actual patched code directly instead, so it can't give that false positive again.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.08.16...2026.08.27
2026.08.27.title: 2026.08.27 - Patch Should Survive Game Updates

2026.09.02.description:
### Fixed
- Reconnecting the client to a different room could fail with "The server is running a different multiworld than your client is. (invalid seed_name)" and silently not log in. It should now be fixed by clearing the stale seed_name before each new connection attempt.
- After a Northgard update, applying the patch could silently re-patch the stale pre-update backup and overwrite the freshly-updated game with a repatched OLD build, instead of patching the new one. It should now be fixed by re-checking whether the live install is fresh and vanilla before deciding what to patch.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.08.27...2026.09.02
2026.09.02.title: 2026.09.02 - Fix Stale Backup Re-Patch & Room-Switch Reconnect

2026.09.04.description:
### Fixed
- Non-Linear Mode: the `chapter7_requirement` option was enforced only by the client against real in-game battle wins, invisible to Archipelago's own logic. Fill could freely place one of the other Chapters' own unlock items inside a Chapter 07 location, creating an unwinnable seed the client would never let you escape. Chapter 07's region is now also gated in logic on holding enough of the other Chapters' items, matching the client's count (Chapter 01's precollected item counts toward the requirement, same as in-game).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.09.02...2026.09.04
2026.09.04.title: 2026.09.04 - Non-Linear Chapter 7 Requirement Logic Fix
